objective: Correct the Live Output timeline renderer for the exact reported MCP tool_result envelope, with bounded normalization and regression coverage.
prior_behavior: timelineEventFromObject had no case for a top-level {type:'user', message:{role:'user', content:[...]}} envelope. It fell through to the generic path, where resultTextFrom found no string fields (message.content is an array, not a string) and jsonSummary(event) rendered only 'Structured event: type, message' -- the numbered source excerpt never reached the readable display.

added: boundedUtf8Slice(text, maxBytes) -- deterministic UTF-8 byte-bounded slice
boundedToolResultText(text) -- applies TOOL_RESULT_TEXT_MAX_BYTES with a '...[truncated]' fallback marker

redactPreserveLines(value) -- strips control chars but preserves newline/carriage-return/tab (unlike redactDisplayText, which collapses whitespace), then applies the existing path/token redaction regexes

toolResultBlockText(content, depth) -- unwraps a tool_result content payload: string first-class, content-block arrays ({type:'text', text}), and the legacy nested {content:{content:'...'}} shape one level deep only, bounded by TOOL_RESULT_MAX_DEPTH and TOOL_RESULT_MAX_ITEMS

toolResultEventFromUserMessage(event, rawLine) -- recognizes the {type:'user', message:{role:'user', content:[...]}} envelope, performs at most one bounded JSON-string decode when message.content itself arrives as a JSON string (gated by TOOL_RESULT_DECODE_MAX_BYTES), extracts every tool_result block's text, and renders a single 'Tool result' (or 'Tool result (N)' for multiple) row whose message is the excerpt itself -- never the outer type/message/role/tool_use_id keys
fix.wired_into: timelineEventFromObject, called immediately after the existing claudeStreamContentBlockDelta handling and before the generic nestedResult/jsonSummary fallback, so all previously passing shapes (assistant/stream/tool/error/ANSI/order/truncation, signature_delta suppression) are unaffected
